claims.assessment: Source-aligned: Element 17 is numeric with a maximum length of eight bytes. The statement omits that the representation has two assumed decimal places.

claims.claim: Cash Amount: Variable up to 8 digits with two decimal places, identifies cash back amount of a transaction.
claims.assessment: Source-aligned with the variable eight-digit, two-assumed-decimal representation and cash-back purpose.

sourceFinding.additionalRule: When a merchant supports Interlink's Optional Cash Back Fee, Element 17 includes the cash-back amount plus the fee.
sourceFinding.caution: Element 17 total cash semantics are distinct from its format/range, and Segment 157 amount reconciliation is another separate obligation.

independentTestAssessment.existingRuleScope: Total cash amount semantics; not the Element 17 range/length boundary.
independentTestAssessment.candidateDesign: One scenario with minimum, maximum, zero, and over-maximum field-value vectors. Optional fee calculation and total-cash semantics are not inferred.

aiCaseReview.conclusion: All 12 frozen candidate payload observations declare Segment 100 Element 17 omitted. None demonstrates its eight-digit maximum, range, assumed decimals, cash-back purpose, or optional fee treatment.

adjudicationGaps: Confirm the authorized cash-back transaction, currency, and amount encoding context.
Confirm whether the merchant supports the optional Interlink Cash Back Fee and how that fee is included.
Keep range/length validation distinct from total cash semantics and Segment 157 reconciliation.
Review complete fixtures and expected outcomes with the authorized Test owner before promotion or execution.
